cases.name: Protect the Joy Anchor
cases.prompt: My work window is 11:30–13:00. Protect lunch walk 12:00–12:30. I need a continuous 45-minute focus block.
expectations: Finds only two separate 30-minute free windows.
Reports no continuous 45-minute slot in the window.
Offers to move the focus task or extend the work window.

cases.name: Weekly draft offline
cases.prompt: Draft a bill review every Monday at 09:00 in America/Chicago, 20 minutes long, with a 10-minute alert. No calendar is connected.
expectations: Creates a weekly Monday rule with America/Chicago.
Sets the draft alert at 08:50 local time.
Does not claim an event or alert was created.

cases.name: Detect time ambiguity
cases.prompt: A colleague says meet at 9 tomorrow in their time. We have no date context or time zones. Put it in my calendar draft.
expectations: Preserves 9 as the sender's stated local time.
Requests calendar date and the relevant zones.
Returns a pending draft without claiming a calendar write.
